messages:
Rina: FYI  launching an Orion pre-renewal QBR packet. Request: 90-day token econ snapshot, short MRR vs spend bridge, and a 1-page ops ask listing exact support we need. Who owns which piece?
Priya: Ill orchestrate. Dan - can you grab the token/day trend and a simple scenario model? Marta - prompt-family breakdown + quick wins. Sam - can you own the one-pager and customer-facing asks?
Dan: On it. Will pull 90d tokens, peak-day callouts, and a simple stress scenario (base / +30% activation / -12% with optimizations). Expect CSV + small heatmap link.
Marta: I'll sample top 500 calls and tag families: long transcript summarize, mass-email few-shot, nightly embedding batches. Ill include avg tokens per call and recommended mitigations.
Sam: I'll draft the ops one-pager: 3 asks (temporary quota bump, 2 sprint dev time for prompt refactor, enablement session). Will include suggested wording for the CS rep to send.
Priya: Alert thresholds to surface in the deck: +12% MTD and +28% absolute. Also flag any day with >35% of monthly tokens in a single 24h window.
alerts-bot: Forecast file uploaded: /team-shared/orion/forecasts/1819993333.csv. Console alerts set at +12% MTD and +28% absolute. Owners: @Priya, @Dan.
Dan: Quick preview of scenario numbers:
```
Scenario,EstMonthlyInferCost,Notes
Base,$3,450,current
Activation+30%,$4,485,high-traffic push
Optimized-12%,$3,036,after batching/quant
```
Marta: Mitigation playbook (short): 1) schedule offline embedding windows (nightly), 2) enable prefix caching for transcripts, 3) reduce few-shot examples in mass-email flow, 4) set rate-limit guardrail for bulk endpoints. Ill add concrete config snippets.
Rina: Great. Sam—please post the one-pager WIP in #customer-docs and tag Orion owners. Also capture two sample prompts they'd accept lower fidelity on (we'll use those in the QBR appendix).
Sam: Will do. Draft will be up in #customer-docs by tomorrow morning.
Priya: Add a 2-question poll to the enablement slide: "Which jobs can be deferred to nightly windows?" and "Which outputs can tolerate lower fidelity to save tokens?" Capture answers live.
Dan: Adding the poll. Also Ill monitor the next 48h for any spike >20% day-over-day and post an alert here if seen.
Rina: Thanks all. If anyone spots an outlier in the next day, drop it here and well decide on an emergency quota/rollback. :thumbsup:
